notes.title: Permanent removal from STORE!
notes.content:
[b]This game will be permanently removed from store![/b]

My reasons are: I lost the main files.... I cant update or patch this game anymore,
I am also not happy with this game.

This game felt like it was very repetitive compared to my other steam games, I wasnt inspired when making this.... and  the result is that even tough the game works... it looks ugly...

I wanna make different games that engages people and drive them in.

I feel like this game was some sort of rush and it doesnt looks good.

Why am I taking this decision now??

- Its very hard to take decisions on your own... just think about it... how many wrong decision you took in your life? Well I also regret some of my decisions...

I am learning GameMaker now and have plans for making crazy games!

Anyways thank you everyone for allowing me the oportunity to fix myself!
